{{Treasure Trails Guide Ciphers Intro}}
<noinclude>
A Caesar shift is a change of location in the regular alphabet, for example ABC becomes BCD if shifted once forwards, or ZAB if shifted once backwards.

Since there are only 25 possible shift distances, brute-forcing all possibilities is easy to do.
